in_hebrew.name: Finbur
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Finbur הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. From the Old Celtic name Finna, which means 'fair' or 'handsome'. This name was popular among the ancient Celts and was believed to bring good fortune.

in_greek.name: Finbur
in_greek.meaning: Χριστιανικό όνομα που σημαίνει Fair, Handsome
in_greek.long_meaning: Finbur είναι ένα χριστιανικό όνομα με βαθιά πνευματική σημασία στον χριστιανικό πολιτισμό. From the Old Celtic name Finna, which means 'fair' or 'handsome'. This name was popular among the ancient Celts and was believed to bring good fortune.

in_latin.name: Finbur
in_latin.meaning: Nomen Christianum quod significat Fair, Handsome
in_latin.long_meaning: Finbur est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. From the Old Celtic name Finna, which means 'fair' or 'handsome'. This name was popular among the ancient Celts and was believed to bring good fortune.
